words: a car parked at the side pulled out into the ego's lane at 20 km/h just ahead (CARLA ParkingCutIn), and the ego did not brake enough: it collided at t 8.4. As in StaticCutIn, RSS put the duty on the car pulling out, so no ego violation, but a collision. The card expected responder brake_lon; the planner's progress stage did not brake either (no brake_follow or keep_lead) while the facts carried lead_slow, which nina's review asks the ruling to look at: does dangerous(lead) hold the planner off when the response asked is lateral only?
